headline: Astral Foods Earnings More Than Double Despite Ongoing Strike Costs
summary: South African poultry producer Astral Foods reported headline earnings more than doubled for the period, though management noted full costs from a Festive labor strike remain undetermined.
why: Astral Foods is one of South Africa's largest integrated poultry producers, listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

impacts.name: Astral Foods
impacts.why: Headline earnings more than doubling provided strong underlying operational performance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong financial earnings figures outweighed labor dispute concerns.
